subject: Finalizing pavilion power & freight window — action items and collateral ETA
body:
From: Anna Hamilton <anna.hamilton@fastfreight.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai; marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pavilion layout — initial freight windows and power availability

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Attached is the initial power plan and the draft freight windows for Pavilion B at Lakeside. Power is confirmed as 200A/phase at the north utility riser (see page 2). Standard drayage applies; if you need forklift during install, please flag that now since standalone forklift slots are limited the week of load-in.

A couple of quick notes:
- If you need dedicated 110V circuits for demo kiosks, we can quote that separately.
- Generator tie-in is available only for island booths >400 sq ft.

Let me know if the power panel labeling works for your electrician.

Best,
Anna
Fast Freight Logistics
--
Attachment: power_plan_v2.pdf (diagram + panel legend)

---

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: anna.hamilton@fastfreight.com; grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pavilion layout — initial freight windows and power availability

Thanks Anna — useful start. Two follow-ups from our side:
1) Freight windows: we need an additional early slot on Tuesday 4/20 to receive a pallet of printed rollups (fragile). Can you pencil that in as a tentative?
2) Power: we will run one demo PC + 2 chargers + one 75\" panel. Will that fit in the 200A allocation if we don’t request a dedicated 110V run?

Grace — can you confirm whether we plan a backwall monitor or an inline 10x20 with a monitor stand? That affects power layout and cable raceways.

-Marissa
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0136

From: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai; grace.oconnor@redwood.ai; ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: anna.hamilton@fastfreight.com; liam@lakesideexpo.com
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pavilion layout — initial freight windows and power availability

Quick update from staging / production: we are building the booth for a 10x20 inline, backwall monitor (single 75\") and two demo towers (each ~5A under continuous load). If we keep everything on 120V circuits at standard distro, the 200A service is ample; the more relevant constraint is the number of duplex outlets on the floor pockets.

Action items for Redwood ops:
- Grace: confirm final collateral manifest (how many crates + skids) so I can reserve forklift time.
- Ben: please sign off on monitor mounting spec and whether you want monitor hardwired to the AV vendor or us to bring HDMI extenders.

Diego
Production Lead | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai

---

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai; marissa.cole@redwood.ai; grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: anna.hamilton@fastfreight.com; liam@lakesideexpo.com
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pavilion layout — initial freight windows and power availability

Diego — I prefer AV handled by Lakeside preferred vendor for liability and to avoid awkward HDMI runs. Please proceed with vendor quote and include:
- Single 75\" VESA mount (portrait orientation)
- On-site AV technician for install + two hours troubleshooting on opening day
- HDMI + 20m active extender if required

Also adding a note: the booth collateral manifest has shifted — three more literature racks added. Grace, can you update the manifest and send the CSV so I can add to the crate labels?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai; marissa.cole@redwood.ai; diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: anna.hamilton@fastfreight.com; liam@lakesideexpo.com; liz@cloudsummit.com
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 17:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pavilion layout — initial freight windows and power availability

Thanks all — a quick summary and next steps: 

Summary:
- Booth footprint: 10x20 inline, backwall 75\" monitor (portrait), two demo towers, three literature racks.
- Power: use Lakeside 200A riser; no dedicated 110V run needed. Anna will confirm duplex outlet counts and add one dedicated floor pocket for the demo station.
- Freight: Marissa — tentative early Tuesday 4/20 pallet receive confirmed with Anna (pending final manifest). Friday load-in window confirmed as 06:00–10:00 local; Anna will add forklift time.

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Grace: upload updated collateral_manifest_3-2.csv to Drive by Thu 03/05 EOD (DONE). Link below.
- Marissa: confirm fragile pallet contents and crate labels by Fri 03/06.
- Ben: approve AV vendor quote once Lakeside sends it (expected 03/06).
- Diego: reserve onsite install crew; request 2-hour buffer on opening day.
- Anna / Lakeside: finalize power labeling and add the extra floor pocket; finalize forklift slot.

Attachments I uploaded: power_plan_v2.pdf, freight_windows_edited.xlsx, collateral_manifest_3-2.csv
Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0B9-power-plan

If there are no objections I will send the finalized manifest and sign the rental contract (DocuSign) by Friday.

Best,
Grace Occonnor
Head of Field Events | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 510-555-0112
